title: Privacy policy
intro: How Cognexa handles information about the people who visit this site and the teams we work with.
draftNotice: DRAFT STRUCTURE. LEGAL COPY TO BE SUPPLIED BY COGNEXA AND REVIEWED BEFORE PUBLISHING.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Cognexa is a behavioural-science and consumer-insights agency with offices in London, UK and Bangalore, India. This section will name the legal entities that control information and how to reach them.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: This section will list the information collected through this site: contact and booking details, messages sent through the form, and analytics data about how pages are used.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: This section will explain each purpose, such as replying to briefs, scheduling calls, improving the site, and the lawful basis that applies to each.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This section will describe the cookies and measurement tools in use, what each does, and how a visitor can accept, decline or change their choice.

sections.heading: Sharing and processors
sections.body: This section will name the categories of service providers that handle information on our behalf and the conditions that apply to them.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: This section will state the retention period for each type of information and what happens when it expires.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: This section will set out the rights available to visitors in the UK, EU, India, the US and Canada, and how to exercise them.

sections.heading: International transfers
sections.body: This section will explain how information moves between our offices and providers, and the safeguards that apply.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: This section will summarise the measures used to protect information. It will describe practice only as confirmed by Cognexa.

sections.heading: Contact and complaints
sections.body: This section will give the contact route for privacy questions and the regulators a visitor can approach.
